prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: Trend champion catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) with strong overall RMSE (583.42), while seasonality champion FT_rf leads with 0.675 seasonal correlation. Overall champion ONLY_FT_rf has lowest RMSE (449.97). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 4.27) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.088) suggest robust median/trimmed mean combination over simple averaging.
